package com.acme.inventory;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Disabled;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class StockLevelServiceTest {

    private static final int LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 10;

    @Mock
    private StockRepository stockRepository;

    private StockLevelService service;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        service = new StockLevelService(stockRepository, LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD);
    }

    @Test
    void availableIsOnHandMinusReserved() {
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-1")).thenReturn(40);
        when(stockRepository.reserved("SKU-1")).thenReturn(15);

        assertEquals(25, service.available("SKU-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void availableIsNeverNegative() {
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-1")).thenReturn(3);
        when(stockRepository.reserved("SKU-1")).thenReturn(5);

        assertEquals(0, service.available("SKU-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFlagLowStockBelowThreshold() {
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-1")).thenReturn(9);

        assertTrue(service.isLowStock("SKU-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFlagLowStockAtThreshold() {
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-1")).thenReturn(LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD);

        assertTrue(service.isLowStock("SKU-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void notLowWhenAboveThreshold() {
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-1")).thenReturn(11);

        assertFalse(service.isLowStock("SKU-1"));
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @ValueSource(strings = {"", " ", "sku with spaces"})
    void rejectsMalformedSku(final String sku) {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> service.available(sku));
    }

    @Test
    void unknownSkuHasZeroAvailable() {
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-404")).thenReturn(0);
        when(stockRepository.reserved("SKU-404")).thenReturn(0);

        assertEquals(0, service.available("SKU-404"));
    }

    @Test
    void snapshotContainsEverySku() {
        when(stockRepository.allSkus()).thenReturn(List.of("SKU-1", "SKU-2"));
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-1")).thenReturn(4);
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-2")).thenReturn(30);

        Map<String, Integer> snapshot = service.snapshot();

        assertEquals(Map.of("SKU-1", 4, "SKU-2", 30), snapshot);
    }

    @Test
    void thresholdIsConfigurable() {
        StockLevelService strict = new StockLevelService(stockRepository, 50);
        when(stockRepository.onHand("SKU-2")).thenReturn(30);

        assertTrue(strict.isLowStock("SKU-2"));
    }

    @Test
    @Disabled("waiting for the warehouse API sandbox; see INV-102")
    void syncsWithWarehouse() {
        service.syncWithWarehouse();

        verify(stockRepository).markSynced();
    }
}
